previousSemanticAuthority.source: original PDF (the same bytes as the current authority)

supersededBecause: the current authority names every occurrence and binds each one exactly to the source, independently of the engine and of the previous count; the previous authority is a total without occurrence identities

historicalAuthorityDelta.meaning: a difference between two authorities over the same PDF; not evidence that the current Gold misses any occurrence
historicalAuthorityDelta.followUp: a historical delta audit only after the Gold and the raw blind score are committed: source-level evidence only, never engine predictions; the previous review's own record names the 8 occurrences its re-audit added (all repeated display titles, which the current Gold contains)
historicalAuthorityDelta.goldRevisionRule: a Gold error found later becomes a new Gold revision with its own provenance; the blind score stays scored against the Gold frozen at the reveal

membershipDecision.authorization: user, 2026-09-25: run the held-out chain continuously; only a review's ambiguous patterns go to the user before the Gold freeze
